snippet.title: The Lacerator - Official New Demo Trailer | Secret Sauce Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Lose a limb? You’ll adapt in The Lacerator! Watch the latest trailer for The Lacerator to learn more about the game's protagonist and see how losing limbs affects gameplay in this upcoming game, described as a titillating mix of survival horror and trashy '80s film. The Lacerator will be available on PC, and a new demo is out now on Steam.
